purpose: Parallel non-decisional robustness and sequence-risk attack while the 15m TFG x Kraken proxy is queued. Reuse the exact DH03 gauntlet stress axes, profiles, repetitions and seed; adapt only the R denominator to the already-frozen TFG cost-inclusive risk convention before opening outcomes.

TFG_R_translation_frozen_before_outcomes.stop_gap_rule: If frozen exit_reason is STOP, subtract stop_gap_extra_R after the cost-inclusive base R calculation. This preserves the semantic meaning of +0.50R or +1.00R adverse stop slippage rather than scaling it by stop distance.
TFG_R_translation_frozen_before_outcomes.reason: The frozen TFG OOS setup defines net R with a cost-inclusive denominator. Using DH03's stop-distance-only denominator would silently change TFG risk semantics. Stress axes themselves are unchanged.

stage_A_full_factor_ledger_stress.limitation: Trade-ledger sequencing diagnostic only; does not claim exact intraday Kraken MDL/floating-equity path.

stage_B_correlation_stress.note: Pure portfolio stress algebra reused unchanged from DH03; it is independent of trade sample.

stage_C_monte_carlo_sequence_risk.sample_unit: all 40 frozen resolved trades sharing the same UTC entry date are aggregated as one block to retain same-day cross-symbol clustering
stage_C_monte_carlo_sequence_risk.horizon_blocks: same number of distinct historical UTC entry days as the TFG 2025 sample
stage_C_monte_carlo_sequence_risk.limitation: Only 40 resolved trades / approximately 30 UTC entry-day blocks exist, so Monte Carlo uncertainty and regime concentration must be reported prominently. Static-MDD sequence risk only; no exact Kraken intraday MDL probability.

stage_D_policy.automatic_next_step: If the queued 001F 15m proxy yields robust survivors, combine its MTM evidence with this gauntlet. No manual winner selection and no retroactive stress threshold changes.

research_tier_evidence.RESEARCH_DIAMOND_candidate_condition: positive frozen OOS confirmation already exists AND severe predeclared robustness remains materially positive; this sample-size-limited diagnostic alone cannot confer the label
research_tier_evidence.EXECUTION_DIAMOND_candidate_condition: requires prospective forward/shadow execution robustness and operational detector validation
research_tier_evidence.PRODUCTION_DIAMOND_condition: requires authoritative platform execution compatibility and separate real-capital authorization
